answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because ferrous only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, copper is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any mesa approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
